description: Check the stored redirect rules (cvrt-seo-manager 1.15.0+, feature redirect_audit). Runs the pending one-time rewrite of exact sources, then returns { normalised, rewrite, findings: [{ code, message, ids, ... }], known_hosts }. Codes: duplicate_source (winner + ids that never fire), normalise_failed, idn_target_host, target_host_from_capture, missing_leading_slash, foreign_source_host, external_target_host (one per host, host field; confirm an intended host with seo_redirects_known_hosts); from cvrt-seo-manager 1.17.0 also redirect_chain (an enabled rule whose target is redirected again) and redirect_loop (the chain comes back), one finding per rule with source, target, hops [{ id, url, target }], final (final target; '' for 410/451 or a truncated walk), loop and truncated (the walk hit its limit). Point a chained rule straight at final. The same findings show as an admin notice.
name: seo_redirects_audit
